evidences.evidence_quote: RF. ... Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) [95], or by collecting RF emanations from a microphone [96]. Across these studies, the average source-to-attacker distance is about 3.6 m, with some systems reaching up to 8 m [88], [92]. The accuracy of the speech recognition can be as high as 0.94 at 1 m [95] or WER = 0.06 at 2 m [96].
evidences.evidence_context: RF. Wi-Fi signals, for example, have been utilized to profile mouth movements [85] and detect loudspeakers' vibrations [86], where the distance between the sound source and the signal transmitter is around 2 m and the accuracy is above 0.8. More recent work has focused on millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar [87], [88], [89], [90], [91], [92], [93], [94], Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) [95], or by collecting RF emanations from a microphone [96]. Across these studies, the average source-to-attacker distance is about 3.6 m, with some systems reaching up to 8 m [88], [92]. The accuracy of the speech recognition can be as high as 0.94 at 1 m [95] or WER = 0.06 at 2 m [96].
